- Goal: show a 30–45 minute throughput/latency walkthrough and then book a 60-minute follow-up for an in-situ stress test on reserved capacity if you want to proceed.
- Pre-demo ask: can you confirm peak QPS (or tokens/sec) you expect and an example prompt length distribution? That helps us pick the right model + quantization profile.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 2027-12-08 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2027-12-09 09:00–09:45
- Thu 2027-12-09 16:00–16:45

I’ve attached a short checklist and intake form — if you can send back the throughput estimates and any firewall/VPN constraints we’ll be able to run a dry-run ahead of the call.

If none of the slots work, tell me your local timezone + a couple of options and we’ll align.

—

Subject: Re: Demo request from self-signup (Dedicated capacity)

Thanks Chloe — appreciate the quick turnaround. Wed 10:00 PST works for me for the initial walkthrough.

Answers to your asks:
- Peak: ~220 QPS (averaged across short bursts), expected steady-state ~40 QPS.
- Prompt distribution: 60% short (<50 tokens), 30% medium (50–200), 10% long (>200).
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 250ms for short prompts under reserved capacity.
- Firewall: outbound traffic allowed, but all inbound requests must come from our corporate bastion (ops@novusai.com can share IP list).

I’m attaching a small internal brief (novus-throughput-brief.xlsx) with representative payload sizes. For the stress test we’ll want to see a short run at the peak QPS.

See you Wed 10:00 PST — please send calendar invite and any VC link.

Best,
Alex
Head of Platform Engineering
NovusAI

Ben / Neha — forwarding NovusAI intake. They confirmed Wed 10:00 PST (tomorrow) for the initial 30–45m walkthrough and provided throughput numbers. Key notes: peak ~220 QPS, steady ~40 QPS, p95 target 250ms, corp IP whitelist required.

Operational asks:
- Neha: can you run a dry-run on Reserved pool staging with a sample workload matching the attached spreadsheet? Focus on short prompts for p95. If we can get a baseline capture (token/sec, p95, GPU util) that would be perfect.
- Ben: please take point on the call — outline the model variants we’ll show and the fallback plan if we hit capacity constraints during the stress test. My suggested fallback sequence:
  1) demo on curated 8-bit quant model (lower cost, slightly longer p95)
  2) if we need lower latency, switch to an unquantized variant pinned to a single GPU instance for the stress test
  3) if we still need headroom, route bursts to hosted fallback and show routing policy in Console

Slots I’d like to propose for the 60m stress run (if Novus wants it after the walkthrough):
- Thu 12/09 11:30–12:30 PST
- Thu 12/09 15:00–16:00 PST
- Fri 12/10 09:30–10:30 PST

I’ve attached the redwood checklist and the intake form I sent them. I’ll create the calendar invite for tomorrow’s walkthrough and include Alex + ops.

—
Chloe
